drafter.private_reasoning: Remove the embedded tracked deletion before sending. Strengthen the mutual protections with clear use limits, standard exclusions, compelled-disclosure procedures, return/destruction obligations, and longer confidentiality survival without introducing client-specific sensitive information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our proposed first-round revisions to the mutual NDA. We have clarified permitted use and handling, added customary exclusions and compelled-disclosure language, and revised the confidentiality period to five years, with trade secrets protected for so long as they remain trade secrets. We have also removed the internal tracked note from the outgoing draft. Please let us know your thoughts.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE AND CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. The parties wish to evaluate and, if mutually agreed, pursue a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). “Confidential Information” means any nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of a party or its representatives to the other party or its representatives, in any form, that is marked confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature or the circumstances of disclosure. Confidential Information includes the existence and status of discussions concerning the Purpose.
edits.name: Purpose and Confidential Information

edits.text: 2. USE AND PROTECTION. The receiving party may use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and may disclose it only to its and its affiliates’ directors, officers, employees, financing sources, and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations or professional duties at least as protective as this Agreement. The receiving party shall protect Confidential Information using at least reasonable care and no less than the care it uses to protect its own similarly sensitive information. These obligations do not apply to information the receiving party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure; (c) is received lawfully from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of or reference to Confidential Information.
edits.name: Use and Protection

edits.text: 3. TERM; DURATION. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. The obligations of confidentiality and restricted use continue for five years from the date of each disclosure; provided that, with respect to any information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law, those obligations continue for so long as the information remains a trade secret.
edits.name: Term and Duration

edits.text: 4. COMPELLED DISCLOSURE; RETURN; REMEDIES. If the receiving party is legally required to disclose Confidential Information, it shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the disclosing party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate, at the disclosing party’s expense, in seeking a protective order or other appropriate remedy. Upon the disclosing party’s request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information, except that it may retain copies required by law or maintained in routine archival backups, in each case subject to this Agreement. A breach may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate; the disclosing party may seek injunctive relief, in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity.
edits.name: Compelled Disclosure, Return, and Remedies

Please also remove “to the extent reasonably practicable” from the return/destruction obligation and clarify that retained archival backups may not be accessed except as required for routine system recovery and remain subject to the Agreement.
